title:
Gear Housing
REMOVAL OF GEAR HOUSING
ocr_text:
STEERING — Power Steering                                                                                                SR-27

Gear Housing
REMOVAL OF GEAR HOUSING

[Diagram showing Steering Gear Housing Assembly, Intermediate Shaft, Bracket and Grommet, Tie Rod, and Cotter Pin with torque specifications: 770 [56, 76], 350 [25, 34], 600 [43, 59]]

kgcm [ft-lb, N·m]  : Specified torque
●  Non-reusable part

1. REMOVE INTERMEDIATE SHAFT
   (See step 2 on page SR-4)

2. DISCONNECT TIE ROD END
   (a) Remove the cotter pin and nut holding the knuckle arm to the tie rod.
   (b) Using SST, disconnect the knuckle arm from the tie rod.
   SST 09611-22012

3. DISCONNECT RETURN LINE AND PRESSURE LINE
   Using SST, disconnect return and pressure lines. Use a container to catch the power steering fluid.
   SST 09631-22020

4. REMOVE GEAR HOUSING ASSEMBLY
   (a) Remove the gear housing bracket set bolts.
   (b) Remove the housing assembly.
